newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh c. bank cuts refinancing rate to 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh c. bank cuts refinancing rate to 21 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Kazakhstan said on Tuesday it was lowering its refinancing rate as of July 1 to 21 percent from 24 percent.

A National Bank press release said the decision was made "taking into account the changing dynamics of inflation and the condition of the internal financial market". It said the bank was also cutting its Lombard rate to 19 percent annually from 23 percent and the overnight rate to 17 percent from 21 percent.
